Put here your SEGA System 16 and System 18 games as MAME romsets, one
.zip each, with the names MAME uses (goldnaxe.zip, shinobi.zip,
mwalk.zip ...). A clone also needs its parent's zip.

s16-pi creates here: saves/ (save states, DIP switches), shots/
(screenshots), s16pi.cfg, pads.cfg and LOG.TXT.
